contexts.text: Every least movement of man's life has a continuous series of consequences to eternity... AC 6490. SE 2483. SE 2629. SE 2714. SE 3403.
What is prior... produces series of consequences to eternity...
If the eye is in good as its end, the man is in the sight of consequences...
Therefore they with whom truths and goods are conjoined according to the form of Heaven, see consequences in series...
